messages.text: New joinee tip: if `make migrate` fails with 'connection refused', the postgres container isn't up yet. Run `docker compose up -d postgres` and wait ~5 seconds.
Reminder: never store money as a float. We use integer cents everywhere — catalog price_cents, order total_cents, everything. See architecture.md.
If the login smoke test is flaky locally too, it's PAY-101, not your machine. Re-run `make smoke`.
Deploy access is managed by the platform team. Open a request in #platform-requests; do not share prod credentials in DMs.
The API explorer at /docs is the fastest way to learn the endpoints — try it before reading the code.
If checkout returns a duplicate order, check you're sending an Idempotency-Key header. See orders.md — that's ORD-405.
Catalog reads are cached in Redis for 60s, so a price change can take up to a minute to show locally. Not a bug.
